precepts.text: Be in pain, and labour to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail. No matter what we are going through, we must be in pain and do this work to bring forth the kingdom.
precepts.point: Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief. Rest is entered by labour; that is the paradox the wilderness generation never accepted.

note.label: 70 Times 7: The Perfection of Mercy Through Christ

precepts.why:
“For he that is entered into his rest, he also hath ceased from his own works, as God did from his.” Paul is making a comparison between our works and God’s. God worked, then rested; so must we. Micah shows the labour: “Be in pain, and labour to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail: for now shalt thou go forth out of the city.”

No matter what we are going through, brothers and sisters, we have to be in pain and do this work. Be in pain to bring forth the kingdom of heaven on earth.

That is why Paul says “Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief.” Labour, labour in pain, bring forth your works to enter into that rest, which is the kingdom. Rest is entered by labour. The generation in the wilderness fell because of unbelief; the daughter of Zion must travail to bring forth.

precepts.text: Be in pain, and labour to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail, for thou shalt go even to Babylon. Like labour, the pains come and go and grow worse as the time draws near; keep labouring through them.
precepts.point: Sisters, a brother who is never in a camp video and never teaches is a gamble; when tribulation comes he goes back to the world.

note.label: Cyber Warfare: The Mouth Of The Beast

precepts.why:
Paul and Barnabas went about “Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.” The tribulation hasn't fully started; you see it on a certain scale, but it will intensify. It will get worse, and worse, and worse.

Micah says how to go through it: “Be in pain, and labour to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail”. The Bible says to be in pain. Pain is coming, and it has already begun; pay attention to what Trump and these people are doing. But whatever pain you go through, you still have to labour, labouring in this truth.

“for now shalt thou go forth out of the city, and thou shalt dwell in the field, and thou shalt go even to Babylon”. Where are we living today? Babylon: Mystery Babylon the Great, the United States of America.

Why does it say like a woman in travail? Because the pain comes and it goes, and when the baby is close to coming the pains increase and get worse and worse. That is what you see taking place now. Whether this society has another ten or twenty years, as the time draws nearer the pains will increase: the affliction rising against those of us that fear God. Keep labouring through them.

That is why the brother who is not studying and applying the scriptures has no root and will not survive it; when things get real he will be offended, scared, and go back into the world. Sisters, a brother who never teaches and is never in a camp video is a gamble.

precepts.text: Be in pain and labour to bring forth, O daughter of Zion; the daughter of Zion is the children of Israel.
precepts.point: We cannot sit back knowing Christ is coming and not do the work; the time is short, and this is not our rest. We have to bring our brothers and sisters to repentance.

note.label: Joshua 18: The Lots Cast at Shiloh

precepts.why:
“Be in pain, and labour to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail”. The daughter of Zion is the children of Israel, and the word to her is labour. She shall go “even to Babylon; there shalt thou be delivered; there the Lord shall redeem thee from the hand of thine enemies.”

We cannot sit back knowing Christ is coming and not do the work; the time is short, and this is not our rest. The slack spirit of Joshua 18 has to go: we have to be in pain and labour to bring our brothers and sisters to repentance.

precepts.text: Israel is told to go forth out of the city, for this is not our rest while our enemies still afflict us.
precepts.point: David had prepared for the house long before, telling Solomon that in his trouble he had laid up a hundred thousand talents of gold, a thousand thousand talents of silver, brass and iron without weight, timber and stone, and workmen in abundance. Solomon did not begin empty-handed; his father had provided the workers and the materials.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 2: Solomon Prepares to Build the House

precepts.why:
“Be in pain, and labour to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail: for now shalt thou go forth out of the city, and thou shalt dwell in the field, and thou shalt go even to Babylon; there shalt thou be delivered; there the Lord shall redeem thee from the hand of thine enemies.”

Solomon was a man of rest, and in his days Israel had peace and quietness, and the strangers in the land were set to Israel's work. Israel is told to go forth out of the city, for this is not our rest while our enemies still afflict us. There the Lord shall redeem us from the hand of our enemies.

precepts.text: In the last days He shall rebuke strong nations afar off and they shall beat their swords into plowshares and learn war no more.
precepts.point: Right now the Most High has not stopped the wars, so this is a prophecy not yet come. We are in the midst of wars and rumors of wars, the beginning of sorrows.

note.label: Psalm 46: God Is Our Refuge and Maketh Wars to Cease

precepts.why:
“Come, behold the works of the Lord, what desolations he hath made in the earth. He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth”. Micah puts the time on it: “in the last days it shall come to pass, that the mountain of the house of the Lord shall be established in the top of the mountains”, and many nations shall say “Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall go forth of Zion, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.” Then: “he shall judge among many people, and rebuke strong nations afar off; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up a sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.”

That is the breaking of the bow and the cutting of the spear. It is in the last days, when he rebukes strong nations afar off and the law goes forth of Zion, and it has not come yet; we are still in the wars and rumours of wars. The God of Jacob, whose house the nations will go up to, is our refuge.

points: Be in pain, and labour to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail: for now shalt thou go forth out of the city, and thou shalt dwell in the field, and thou shalt go even to Babylon; there shalt thou be delivered; there the Lord shall redeem thee from the hand of thine enemies. That is what we are doing now, in pain, labouring to bring forth the word of God. Thou shalt dwell in the field: that is captivity.

There shalt thou be delivered. We will be saved from our enemies in Babylon, in captivity, by our God. There the Lord shall redeem thee from the hand of thine enemies. That is what he said: no man shall buy you, because the Lord himself will buy us. Redeem means to buy, to buy again. The Lord said, I am going to redeem you. I will save you again. Not any man.

note.label: Foundational Babylonian Advocates: Division Among the Dispersion

points: Montage played of the politicians and pundits: "short-term pain for the long-term gain," over and over. They bombed Iran, the gas prices went high, everything went high, and they said, listen, it is a short-term pain; long-term it is going to be worth it. No. Let me tell you what the Bible says: there will be no short-term pain. There will be pain and pain and pain; there will be long-term pain with no gain. They started the war and now they are trying to pull out of it, but they cannot. Why? Because the Lord is behind it. The Lord wants America to do exactly what you see America doing.

News clip played: this week marks 150 days since the war of choice on Iran. He said the war would last five days, then two weeks; it has been 150 days. Regime change did not happen; the Ayatollahs are more entrenched than ever. The nuclear talks have broken down. Their ballistic missile stocks are higher than the Pentagon claims, and they launched more missiles at American troops just on Tuesday. The Houthi rebels are attacking civilian shipping in the Red Sea this week, and the strait of Hormuz is still closed. Americans have already spent nearly 500 dollars per household more on gas since this war began; gas in Delaware is 4.15 a gallon. Victuals are not cheap any more. And another report: the United States carried out fresh strikes on Iran despite a peace agreement signed just weeks ago; the conflict began on February 28th with joint US and Israeli operations. What they did there will cause a global depression, not a recession: a recession is no jobs; a depression is everybody suffering.

Be in pain, and labour to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail. A woman in travail is bringing forth a baby: as the time gets closer, the pain increases, it gets stronger, and it comes closer together. Remember back in the day it would be a couple of years before some war popped off. After 2019, every year something crazy is happening; every month; matter of fact, every week.

For now shalt thou go forth out of the city, and thou shalt dwell in the field, and thou shalt go even to Babylon; there shalt thou be delivered. Right here in Babylon we are going to be delivered. The Lord is going to deliver us here in Babylon.
Be in pain, and labour to bring forth, O daughter of Zion. That pain is affliction; that pain is tribulation; all the bad things that happen when you come to serve the Lord.
And while you are going through that pain, you still have to labour to bring forth. Even though bad things are happening to us, we still have to labour.

In the last days it shall come to pass, that the mountain of the house of the Lord shall be established in the top of the mountains, and it shall be exalted above the hills; and people shall flow unto it.
For the law shall go forth of Zion, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.

He shall judge among many people, and rebuke strong nations afar off; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up a sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
They shall sit every man under his vine and under his fig tree; and none shall make them afraid: for the mouth of the Lord of hosts hath spoken it.

note.label: Micah 4: The Law Shall Go Forth of Zion

points: In that day will I assemble her that halteth, and I will gather her that is driven out, and her that I have afflicted.
I will make her that halted a remnant, and her that was cast far off a strong nation: and the Lord shall reign over them in mount Zion from henceforth, even for ever.
Unto thee shall it come, even the first dominion; the kingdom shall come to the daughter of Jerusalem.

Be in pain, and labour to bring forth, O daughter of Zion: for now shalt thou go forth out of the city, and thou shalt go even to Babylon; there shalt thou be delivered; there the Lord shall redeem thee from the hand of thine enemies.

note.label: Micah 4: The Law Shall Go Forth of Zion

points: Now also many nations are gathered against thee, that say, Let her be defiled, and let our eye look upon Zion.
But they know not the thoughts of the Lord, neither understand they his counsel: for he shall gather them as the sheaves into the floor.
Arise and thresh, O daughter of Zion: for I will make thine horn iron, and I will make thy hoofs brass: and thou shalt beat in pieces many people.
